releases.dataset: Standard Monthly Extract : HES Critical Care

texts.a5d3d1838262: Objective: Device Access will use this data to conduct analysis to identify where within each local health economy medical technological devices can best be used by NHS providers in NHS patient care pathways to improve patient outcomes and to reduce lengths of stay, elective waiting times and diagnostic waiting times. Working through United Kingdom Trade and Investment (UKTI), the Office of Life Sciences (OLS) and the National Institute for Health Research (NIHR), National Institute for Health & Care Excellence (NICE), and working directly with Device Access’ medical technology clients, Device Access will carry out bespoke analysis of the data and provide that analysis to Device Access clients. Such clients are medical technology companies that are or wish to become service providers to the NHS, or UK Government & NHS bodies (who receive services direct from Device Access). This will be in accordance with the UKTI and OLS government-linked priorities of supporting the wider UK health economy and is directly in line HSCIC’s key strategic aims/priorities as set out in “A strategy for the HSCIC 2013-2015”. Processing: The bespoke analysis Device Access will provide to Device Access clients will include only aggregated data with small numbers suppressed and at no point will record level data be supplied within UK or Worldwide. All analytical work will be carried out in line with HES Analysis Guide. Device Access requires 3 historical years of HES data to support the overall patient pathway analysis. This will require the supply of outpatient, inpatient and critical care datasets. Device Access does not hold any other patient record level datasets. Outputs: The outputs will solely be aggregated analysis with small numbers suppressed. Such analysis will be only used :- - Within Applications to NICE for the purpose of Medical Technology Appraisal Program - To support NIHR research studies - To support UK Trade and Investment dialogue - To Support Office of Life Sciences (OLS) Dialogue - To support the adoption of medical technological devices with NHS providers -  For internal decision making by medical device providers  The data will not be used for any direct marketing purpose. Benefits: This HES research on patient care pathways and the impact of the medical technology will be used to support Device Access client’s applications to NICE for the purpose of Medical Technology Appraisal Program (MTEP). NICE can then make informed decisions with regards to ultimate guidance through their evaluations programs. Such analysis will be used by Device Access client’s to allow them to make informed decisions on the suitability of their medical technology in the NHS market, as part of their business strategy/case. The goal of Device Access’ data usage and analysis and its provision of that analysis, at aggregated level to Device Access clients is to help its clients demonstrate to NHS providers where those providers can use medical devices to deliver improvements in both individual patient care and the healthcare system as a whole by improving management of complex patients; reducing waiting times, adverse events, medical errors and avoidable readmissions; improving efficiencies in inpatient care delivery; promoting the use of lower cost delivery settings; and promoting higher NICE guidance compliance rates.
